# Scissors by Sandy

> A private one-chair barber shop in Old Bridge, New Jersey, owned and run by master barber Sandra (Sandy) Mordan. Men's and kids' haircuts, traditional hot towel shaves, beard shaping, facials, scalp treatments, waxing and wedding packages. By appointment only.

## Key facts

- Address: The Shoppes at Old Bridge, 3813 US 9 North, Suite 101, Old Bridge, NJ 08857
- Phone or text: (848) 230-5995
- Book online: https://booksy.com/en-us/1823074_scissors-by-sandy_barber-shop_28627_old-bridge
- Website: https://scissorsbysandy.com/
- Walk-ins: no, by appointment only
- Parking: free, directly outside the suite
- First responders: $5 off their total, every visit
- Gift certificates: available by call or text
- Areas served: Old Bridge, Matawan, Marlboro, Manalapan, Monroe Township, East Brunswick, Sayreville, Aberdeen and Parlin

## Services and prices

### Precision Haircuts

- The Executive: $60, 45 minutes. The house specialty. Wash and cut, shaped entirely with shears — no clippers, no guards — every line judged by eye and cut by hand. It takes longer, and it should: the result grows out softer, sits more naturally, and never leaves a hard shelf across the back.
- The Signature: $50, 40 minutes. Wash and cut. Electric clippers and traditional shears working together, seamlessly blended. A gentle hand throughout — nobody should leave a haircut feeling roughed up.
- The Fresh Fade: $50, 40 minutes. Wash and cut. A clippers-only skin fade, blended by hand from a bare skin line up through the longer hair on top — a graduated blend rather than one uniform length, with sharp edges and a clean modern finish.
- The Regiment: $45, 30 minutes. Wash and cut. The classic crew cut — clippers only, short through the back and sides with a bit more length left on top. A uniform short length rather than a skin fade, so it keeps its shape as it grows. Easy to maintain, endlessly versatile, always a neat and clean finish.
- The Royal Roots: $40, 30 minutes. Wash and cut for my youngest gentlemen, ages 12 and under. Patient, unhurried, and taken as seriously as any cut in the chair. Kids notice when someone takes their time with them.

### Packages

- The Sovereign: $120, 90 minutes. The Executive cut paired with The Majesty Hot Towel Shave.
- The Regent: $115, 85 minutes. The Signature cut paired with The Majesty Hot Towel Shave.
- The Ambassador: $95, 70 minutes. The Signature cut paired with The Royal Hot Towel Shave.
- The Officer: $90, 60 minutes. The Regiment cut paired with The Royal Hot Towel Shave.
- The Gentleman: $80, 70 minutes. The Signature cut paired with The Statesman Beard Shaping.
- The Diplomat: $80, 60 minutes. The Signature cut paired with a Scalp Treatment.

### Signature Shaves & Beard

- The Majesty Hot Towel Shave: $75, 45 minutes. Our most indulgent ritual. Facial steam, exfoliation, warm aromatic towels, a traditional straight-razor shave, and a customized mini facial to finish. Clients call it calming, soothing, and more than just a shave — you leave feeling brand new.
- The Royal Hot Towel Shave: $55, 30 minutes. A meticulously curated hot towel shave with beard trim. Warm towels and premium products prepare the skin for a traditional straight-razor shave, finished close and comfortable.
- The Statesman Beard Shaping: $35, 30 minutes. Full beard sculpting and detailing with clippers, shaped to your face with clean, deliberate lines. Hot towel included.

### Treatments

- Mini Facial: $50, 30 minutes. A focused facial in thirty minutes: warm steam and towels, a gentle cleanse and exfoliation, a deep pore cleanse, then a hydrating mask and moisturizer suited to your skin. Relaxing on its own or added to any cut.
- Scalp Treatment: $35, 20 minutes. A cleansing, nourishing therapy that soothes the scalp and promotes healthier hair growth. Deeply relaxing on its own or paired with any cut.

### Grooming & Waxing

- Nose Waxing: $25, 10 minutes. Precise removal of nasal hair for a polished look.
- Ear Waxing: $20, 10 minutes. Gentle, hygienic removal of excess ear hair.
- Eyebrow Waxing: $20, 10 minutes. Sculpting and shaping to define your look with precision.

### Color

- Grey Blending: $55, 45 minutes. A refined technique to create a soft, natural transition with our professional grey blending service.
